definition: Ni agace gato kurusha ibindi byose k'ubuzima. Ibinyabuzima byose bigizwe n'utugari. Umubiri w'umuntu ugizwe n'utugari nka tiriyoni 37 z'ubwoko butandukanye.
Ni igice kigizwe n'urukuta rwuzuye kiri imbere mu kagari, gikubiyemo ibikoresho ngengabuzima (DNA). Nucleus iyobora ibikorwa by'akagari kandi ikora nk'ikigo cy'ubuyobozi.

DNA (Deoxyribonucleic acid) ni ikintu cya shimi gitwara amakuru ngengabuzima. DNA igizwe n'uruhererekane rubiri rwa nucleotide (double helix), rufite ibice bita adenine (A), thymine (T), guanine (G) na cytosine (C).

Ni imiterere ya DNA igaragara mu byiciro bitatu – uruhererekane rubiri rwa nucleotide ruzengurutse hamwe. Izo ngingo zihuzwa n'imigozi ya hydrogen iri hagati y'ibice bihuye: A ihuza na T, na G ihuza na C.
Ni molecule ya DNA yizingiye cyane ikikijwe na proteyine. Umuntu afite chromosome 46 muri byinshi mu tugari twe, ziri mu byiciro 23. Utugari tw'ibihera dufite chromosome 23 gusa.
Ni chromosome isanzwe itari iy'igitsina. Umuntu afite chromosome 22 z'autosome (chromosome 1–22), zingana muri byombi ibitsina. Jene ziri kuri autosome zigenga ibiranga umubiri kenshi.
Ni chromosome igena igitsina cy'umuntu mu buryo bwa siyansi. Umuntu afite chromosome ebyiri z'igitsina: X na Y. Ufite XX asanzwe aba umugore, naho ufite XY akaba umugabo.

Ni chromosome ebyiri ziri mu byiciro bimwe, zifite jene zimwe ku murongo umwe – imwe ivuye kuri nyina, indi kuri se. Zingana mu burebure kandi zifite allele z'ibiranga bimwe, ariko allele zishobora gutandukana. (X na Y ku bagabo ni intandukaniro kandi ntabwo bisa burundu.)

Ni igice cy'ibanze cyubaka DNA. Buri nucleotide igizwe na isukari (deoxyribose), igice cya phosphate, n'igice cya nitrogène (A, T, G cyangwa C). Nucleotide zihuzwa hamwe zigakora uruhererekane rurerure rugize umugozi wa DNA.

Ni igice cya nucleotide gitwara amakuru ngengabuzima ubwacyo. Muri DNA harimo ibice bine bya nitrogène: adenine (A), thymine (T), guanine (G) na cytosine (C). Muri RNA, thymine isimburwa na uracil (U). Uko ibyo bice byakurikiranyijwe ni byo bigira kode y'akagari.

Ni ibice bibiri bihuye byifatanya muri double helix ya DNA: adenine (A) ihuza na thymine (T), naho guanine (G) igahuza na cytosine (C). Iri tegeko ry'ihuzwa ry'ibice rituma buri mugozi wa DNA ukoreshwa nk'urugero mu gukoporora.
Ni igice cyihariye cya DNA kirimo amabwiriza yo kubaka proteyine runaka. Umuntu afite hafi jene 20,000 kugeza 25,000 zikora proteyine.
Ni ahantu hihariye kuri chromosome jene runaka iherereye. Loci (umubare munini) z'ama chromosome asa afite allele z'iyo jene imwe.
Ni DNA yose iri mu tugari tw'ikiremwa – chromosome zose na jene zose. Genome y'umuntu igizwe n'ibice bihuye bigera kuri miliyari 3.
Ni imwe mu mpinduka za jene ishobora kuboneka kuri locus runaka kuri chromosome. Buri muntu afite allele ebyiri za buri jene – imwe ivuye kuri nyina, indi kuri se.
Ni allele igaragara mu miterere y'umubiri (phenotype) n'iyo umuntu yaba afite kopi imwe gusa. Yandikwa n'inyuguti nkuru, urugero A.
Ni allele igaragara mu phenotype gusa iyo umuntu afite kopi ebyiri (homozygote). Yandikwa n'inyuguti ntoya, urugero a.
Ni igihe allele zombi zigaragara zuzuye mu muntu ufite heterozygote. Urugero: ubwoko bw'amaraso AB, aho allele A na B byombi bigaragara icyarimwe ku tugingo tutukura tw'amaraso.

Ni uburyo bwo kuraga aho umuntu heterozygote agira ikiranga kiri hagati y'ibiranga bibiri bya ba homozygote. Urugero, iyo uhuje indabyo itukura n'iyera hakavuka indabyo z'ipinki, kuraga ntikuba kwuzuye – nta na rimwe allele idominant burundu ku yindi. Byitwa kandi kuraga hagati (intermediate).

Ni sisitemu izwi cyane yo kugena ubwoko bw'amaraso, ishingiye ku bintu biri ku tugingo tutukura tw'amaraso. Jene zitanga ubwoko bw'amaraso A, B, AB na 0. Allele A na B ni codominant, naho 0 ni recessive. Iyi sisitemu ni ingenzi mu gutera amaraso.

Ni sisitemu igaragaza niba ikintu runaka, Rh factor, kiri ku tugingo tutukura tw'amaraso. Ufite Rh factor ni Rh-pozitifu (Rh+), naho udafite ni Rh-negatifu (Rh−). Rh factor ni ingenzi mu gutera amaraso no mu gihe cy'ubutwite.
Ni imiterere ya jene z'umuntu, ni ukuvuga allele afite. Ryandikwa nka AA, Aa cyangwa aa. Genotype ntabwo buri gihe igaragara hanze.
Ni imiterere igaragara n'ibiranga bishobora gupimwa by'ikiremwa, bigenwa na genotype n'ibikorwa by'ibidukikije. Urugero: ibara ry'amaso, ubwoko bw'amaraso, uburebure.
Ni umuntu ufite allele ebyiri zisa (AA cyangwa aa) za jene imwe.
Ni umuntu ufite allele ebyiri zitandukanye (Aa) za jene imwe. Yitwa kandi umutwaza (carrier) niba allele recessive ishobora gutera indwara igihe iri muri kopi ebyiri.
Ni umuntu heterozygote (Aa) ufite allele y'indwara recessive. Umutwaza ni muzima ariko ashobora kwimurira allele y'indwara ku bana be.
RNA (Ribonucleic acid) ni molecule ihuza mu gutwara amakuru kuva kuri DNA kugera kuri proteyine. RNA igizwe n'uruhererekane rumwe kandi ikoresha uracil (U) aho gukoresha thymine (T).
Ni intambwe ya mbere mu gukora proteyine. Muri nucleus, enzyme ya RNA-polymerase isoma urutonde rwa DNA maze igakora molecule ya mRNA ihuye nayo.
Ni messenger RNA. Ni molecule ya RNA y'uruhererekane rumwe, ikaba kopi ya jene, itwara amabwiriza kuva muri nucleus kugera kuri ribosome ziri muri cytoplasm.
Ni igice gito kiri muri cytoplasm gisoma mRNA kikanahuza amino acide kugira ngo hakorwe proteyine. Akenshi yitwa uruganda rw'akagari rukora proteyine.
Ni intambwe ya kabiri mu gukora proteyine. Ribosome isoma urutonde rwa mRNA codon ku yindi maze ikahuza amino acide mu murongo nyawo kugira ngo hakorwe proteyine.
Ni urutonde rw'ibice bitatu muri mRNA rugena amino acide runaka. Urugero, AUG (codon itangira) igena amino acide ya methionine. Hari codon 64 zishoboka ku bwoko 20 bwa amino acide.
Ni igice cy'ibanze cyubaka proteyine. Hari amino acide 20 zitandukanye. Uko amino acide ziri mu proteyine zikurikirana ni byo bigena imiterere n'akamaro bya proteyine.
Ni transfer RNA. Ni molecule itwara amino acide nyayo kuri ribosome mu gihe cya translation. Buri tRNA ifite anticodon ihuza na codon iri kuri mRNA.
Ni urutonde rw'ibice bitatu kuri tRNA buhuye na codon runaka kuri mRNA. Ihuzwa ry'ibice bya anticodon na codon rituma amino acide nyayo yinjizwa mu gihe cya translation.
Ni sisitemu rusange ihuza amatsinda y'ibice bitatu bya mRNA (codon) na amino acide. Iyi kode isa cyane mu binyabuzima byose, kigaragaza ko byose bikomoka ku isoko rimwe.
Ni inzira yose akagari gakoresha kugira ngo kubake proteyine hifashishijwe amakuru ari muri DNA. Ibaho mu byiciro bibiri: transcription (DNA → mRNA) na translation (mRNA → proteyine).

Ni ubwoko bwo kugabanya akagari aho akagari kimwe kagabanyamo utugari tubiri tumeze kimwe mu ngengabuzima, buri kamwe gafite chromosome nk'ako kagari-nyina (46 ku muntu). Ikoreshwa mu gukura no gusana umubiri.

Ni ubwoko bwo kugabanya akagari gakora utugari tw'ibihera (amagi na intanga) bifite kimwe cya kabiri cy'umubare wa chromosome (23). Meiosis itanga itandukaniro ry'ingengabuzima binyuze mu ihindurangingo (recombination) no mu igabana ryigenga.

Ni akagari k'ibihera, ni ukuvuga igi cyangwa intanga. Gamete ni haploid kandi ifite itsinda rimwe rya chromosome (23 ku muntu). Iyo gamete ebyiri zihuye mu gihe cyo gutera inda, hakavuka umuntu mushya afite chromosome zuzuye.

Ni akagari gafite itsinda rimwe rya chromosome (n). Utugari tw'ibihera ku muntu ni haploid kandi tugira chromosome 23. Mu gihe cyo gutera inda, utugari tubiri twa haploid duhuriza hamwe tugakora akagari ka diploid.

Ni akagari ka mbere k'umuntu mushya, gakorwa igihe intanga iteye igi. Zygote ni diploid kuko yakiriye itsinda rya chromosome kuri buri muvyeyi. Kuva kuri zygote, umubiri wose ukura hakoreshejwe kugabanya akagari incuro nyinshi.
Ni akagari gafite kopi ebyiri za buri chromosome (2n). Utugari twinshi mu mubiri ni diploid kandi tugira chromosome 46 (ibice 23). Ku muntu byandikwa 2n = 46.
Ni ihindurangingo ry'ibice bya chromosome hagati ya chromosome zisa mu gihe cya meiosis. Bitanga imvange nshya z'allele (recombinant) kandi ni isoko y'ingenzi y'itandukaniro ry'ingengabuzima.

Ni impinduka idahinduka mu rutonde rwa DNA. Ishobora kuvuka ku bwayo, cyangwa itewe n'imirasire cyangwa imiti. Mutation nyinshi zifite ingaruka nto, ariko zimwe zishobora gutera indwara cyangwa guhindura ibiranga.

Ni igishushanyo cy'imbonerahamwe gikoreshwa mu guteganya amahirwe y'ubwoko butandukanye bwa genotype na phenotype ku bana, hashingiwe kuri genotype z'ababyeyi. Cyavumbuwe n'umuhanga mu bumenyi bwa ingengabuzima Reginald Punnett.

Ni guhuza gukurikirana ibiranga bibiri icyarimwe, ni ukuvuga jene ebyiri icyarimwe. Mu gishushanyo cyo guhuza, ababyeyi babiri ba heterozygote (urugero AaBb × AaBb) batanga imvange nyinshi zitandukanye mu bana babo. Bigaragaza ukuntu ibiranga bitandukanye byaragwa mu buryo bwigenga.

Ni kuraga ibiranga jene yabyo iri kuri autosome (chromosome idafite igitsina, ibice 1–22). Bigira ingaruka ku bagabo n'abagore mu buryo bungana. Bishobora kuba dominant (kopi imwe irahagije) cyangwa recessive (hakenewe kopi ebyiri).

Ni kuraga ibiranga jene zabyo ziri kuri chromosome y'igitsina (X cyangwa Y). Kuko abagabo bafite XY naho abagore XX, ibiranga bihuye n'igitsina (urugero, kutabona amabara neza) akenshi biraga mu buryo butandukanye ku bitsina byombi.

Ni ikiranga gikunze kuboneka gihuye n'igitsina, aho ijisho ryibasirwa no gutandukanya amabara amwe, akenshi umutuku n'icyatsi. Jene yabyo iri kuri chromosome X kandi ni recessive, bigatuma abagabo babifitemo kenshi kurusha abagore – kuko umugabo afite chromosome X imwe gusa.

Ni igishushanyo kigaragaza uko ikiranga cyangwa indwara iragwa mu bisekuruza byinshi by'umuryango. Abagore basanzwe bashushanywa mu mizunguruko, abagabo mu makaramu, kandi ibimenyetso byuzuye bigaragaza abafite ikiranga. Bikoreshwa mu kumenya uko kuraga kugenda n'abari abatwaza.
Ni ihuzwa ry'imiterere ngengabuzima (kuraga) n'imiterere y'ibidukikije (environment), bikagena hamwe ibiranga by'umuntu. Ibiranga byinshi bigoye – nk'uburebure n'ubwenge – bigenwa n'ibyo byombi.
Ni ishusho igaragaza itsinda ryuzuye rya chromosome z'umuntu, ryategekanijwe hakurikijwe umubare. Rikoreshwa mu kumenya ibibazo bya chromosome nka trisomy 21 (Down syndrome).
Ni igihe umuntu afite kopi eshatu za chromosome aho kuba ebyiri zisanzwe. Trisomy 21 itera Down syndrome. Ibaho igihe igabanya rya chromosome mu meiosis ritagenze neza (non-disjunction).

Ni uburwayi buterwa n'uko umuntu afite kopi eshatu za chromosome 21 aho kuba ebyiri (trisomy 21). Chromosome y'inyongera igira ingaruka ku gukura no ku miterere y'umubiri, kandi akenshi biterwa n'ibibazo byo kwiga. Ikunda kuvuka biturutse ku ikosa mu gukora utugari tw'ibihera.
Ni indwara iterwa n'impinduka mu bikoresho ngengabuzima. Ishobora kuragwa (urugero, cystic fibrosis, phenylketonuria) cyangwa ikaba iturutse kuri mutation nshya (urugero, Down syndrome).

Ni izina rusange ry'uburyo bwo gusuzuma, gukoporora, no guhindura ibikoresho ngengabuzima. Binyuze mu buhanga bwa jene, abahanga bashobora kwimura jene hagati y'ibinyabuzima, urugero bagatuma bagiteri zikora insuline y'umuntu. Ubu buhanga butanga amahirwe menshi ariko butera n'ibibazo by'imyitwarire.

Ikiremwa cyahinduwe ku bw'ubuhanga bwa jene – ikiremwa ibikoresho byacyo ngengabuzima byahinduwe binyuze mu buhanga bwa jene, urugero kugira ngo gikore insuline, gishobore kurwanya indwara, cyangwa gitange umusaruro mwiza.

Ni molecule ya DNA ntoya, igizwe mu buryo bw'uruziga, iboneka mu buryo busanzwe muri bagiteri, itandukanye na chromosome ya bagiteri. Plasmide zikoreshwa mu buhanga bwa jene nk'uburyo bwo kwinjiza jene z'amahanga mu tugari.
Ni enzyme ica DNA ahantu hihariye hafite urutonde rw'ibice runaka. Ikoreshwa mu buhanga bwa jene mu gukata no gushyiraho ibice bya jene – ni nk'igikoresho cy'igicibwa cya molecule.
Ni DNA irimo urutonde ruturutse ku nkomoko ebyiri cyangwa zirenga, ikorwa hifashishijwe enzyme zigabanya na ligase. Ni umusingi w'ihindurwa ry'ingengabuzima.

Ni igikoresho cya jene gikora neza cyane, gikora nk'igikoresho cy'igicibwa cya DNA gishobora gutegurwa. CRISPR ishobora kubona urutonde nyarwo muri genome ikarugica cyangwa ikarusana – bituma indwara za jene zivurwa.
Polymerase Chain Reaction – ni uburyo bwo gukoporora urutonde rwihariye rwa DNA inshuro miliyoni mu gihe gito. Bukoreshwa mu iperereza ry'ibyaha, gusuzuma indwara, no mu bushakashatsi.

Ni uburyo bwo gusoma no kugereranya DNA, urugero kugira ngo hamenyekane isano cyangwa umuntu amenyekane. Kubera ko DNA ya buri muntu idasanzwe (usibye impanga zavutse ku gi kimwe), icyitegererezo cya DNA gishobora gukoreshwa nk'ikimenyetso cy'urutoki mu iperereza ry'ibyaha no mu gupima ubuse.

Ni ugukora umuntu umwe cyangwa benshi bahuje burundu na jene z'undi muntu. Kubera ko clone (umuntu wakoronwe) afite ibikoresho ngengabuzima bimwe n'inkomoko, basa nk'impanga zavutse ku gi kimwe. Kloning ibaho ku buryo busanzwe mu binyabuzima bimwe na bimwe kandi ishobora gukorwa mu buryo bw'ubuhanga.
